page.overview:
What is 18+?

18+ belongs to LEGO. 18+ is a set designation first used in 2020 as a replacement for the Expert line.

Sets with the 18+ designation are more advanced than standard LEGO sets and are intended for adult builders.

In LEGO, 18+ sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
